title: A Third Of Webpages Published Since Chatgpts Launch Show Signs Of Ai Authorship Study Finds
report:
Researchers have discovered that approximately 35% of web pages published after November 2022 show signs of being written by AI, according to a report by Pew Research released on Thursday. The study used data from the Common Crawl web archive and Open Pangram's technology to detect AI authorship in nearly half a million English-language web pages collected over five years.

The report found that one-third of the filtered sample showed signs of AI authorship, with .com domains showing a higher rate of 10% compared to .edu or .gov domains at around 1%. The study suggests that AI-written content has become more prevalent on the web since the release of ChatGPT in November 2022.

The findings corroborate other studies indicating that a significant portion of online content is now generated by AI, contributing to the increasing presence of bot-generated traffic on the internet.
